amends: l1_background_level_perframe_vs_onstack — it ADDS surfaces, it changes no arm, no knob, no threshold and no falsifier. Written and committed BEFORE any per-set arm reading was taken.
raised_by: a parallel audit session, mid-flight, while arm A was still building; re-derived here from this session's own committed records before being acted on
finding: THE PRE-REGISTERED SURFACE CANNOT EXERCISE ITS OWN FALSIFIERS. The instrument's resolving power was characterised on aug06/set-01 (retained_se 0.0558/0.0708/0.0598) and the pre-registration reads the arms on the 3-set UNION, where the same instrument measures retained_se 0.2871/0.3162/0.1745 — 5.14x / 4.46x / 2.92x worse. The catalogue plane bound moved the other way at the same time, 10.0% on set-01 against 6.4% on the union, so the effect being looked for is SMALLER exactly where the ruler is COARSER.
consequence_falsifier_A: UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION on the union. `retained < 0.90 at >2 SE` requires retained below 0.90 - 2*SE = 0.326 / 0.268 / 0.551, i.e. arm A destroying 67% / 73% / 45% of the starlight relation. The same bar on set-01 is 0.788 / 0.758 / 0.780, i.e. 21% / 24% / 22%. A refutation branch that needs an order of magnitude more destruction than the operator's own catalogue budget is not a test.
consequence_confirmed_equivalent: FIRES BY DEFAULT on the union. With SE_A comparable to SE_B the combined SE is 0.406 / 0.447 / 0.247 about retained_B 1.636 / 1.937 / 1.469, so the arms are declared equivalent unless retained_A lands outside [1.23, 2.04] / [1.49, 2.38] / [1.22, 1.72]. Agreement inside a window that wide is close to guaranteed whatever is true.
why_this_matters_for_the_verdict: a NULL on the union alone would be 'this surface cannot separate anything', which is NOT the pre-registered null 'the arms do not separate'. Reporting the first as the second would be a false negative dressed as a result.
fix: ADD the three PER-SET surfaces as readings alongside the union; do not replace it. The groups route builds a per-set stack before composing, so arm A already produces stack_set-0{1,2,3}_l1arm.fit, and the control's stack_set-0{1,2,3}_full_wcs.fit exist untouched. Each per-set stack is -framing=min and therefore fully covered by construction, so the crop-before-background order does not apply there and no crop is involved. Four readings in total: three at the instrument's MEASURED power, one on the deliverable.
on_stack_comparator_at_the_per_set_level: set-01's already exists from the research pass and is reused, not rebuilt (datasets/aug06/set-01/starlight_work/starlight_subsky1.json: retained 1.2315/1.2740/1.2367 +- 0.0558/0.0708/0.0598, measured on the untouched stack_set-01_full_wcs.fit, whose PIPEREV/STACKCNT still match the record). Sets 02 and 03 get the same treatment built now. NAMING: this is the on-stack LEVEL measured at the per-set surface — it is not 'arm B', which is defined on the union after the pinned crop.
prediction: PRE-REGISTERED, stated before the per-set readings are taken, so it can fail. The proposed mechanism is that the union is a 13-member framing=max mosaic whose sky x V residual AND coverage depth both vary across the canvas, adding scatter to a per-cell relation that a single homogeneous per-set stack does not carry. If that is the cause: (1) the three per-set retained_se land near set-01's 0.056-0.071 rather than near the union's 0.17-0.32; (2) the three per-set readings are MUTUALLY CONSISTENT within their combined SEs; (3) the union's retained_se is worse than ALL THREE. If instead the per-set readings disagree with each other, the mechanism is wrong and the extra scatter is not a mosaic effect — that would be a finding about the field, not about the union.
what_does_not_change: both arms, the one knob, degree 1, dither off, the 0.90 falsifier lines, the CONFIRMED-AS-EQUIVALENT rule, the judge surfaces, and the rule that the instrument gates nothing. The union reading is still taken and still reported as the pre-registered one; it is simply no longer the ONLY one.
